import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
income_edu_data = df[df['Income'].notna()]
sns.boxplot(data=income_edu_data, x='Education', y='Income', ax=axes[0,0], palette='viridis')
axes[0,0].set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
axes[0,0].set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0,0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_data = df[spending_cols].mean()
spending_categories = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(spending_categories)))

axes[0,1].bar(spending_categories, spending_data, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
axes[0,1].set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Average Amount Spent ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Purchase channels distribution
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_data = df[purchase_cols].sum()
purchase_channels = ['Web Purchases', 'Catalog Purchases', 'Store Purchases']
channel_colors = ['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1']

wedges, texts, autotexts = axes[1,0].pie(purchase_data, labels=purchase_channels, colors=channel_colors, 
                                         autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 11})
axes[1,0].set_title('Distribution of Purchases by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Customer demographics heatmap
# Create age groups
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['Age_Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 60, 100], 
                         labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50-60', '60+'])

# Create family size
df['Family_Size'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome'] + 1
df['Family_Category'] = pd.cut(df['Family_Size'], bins=[0, 1, 2, 3, 10], 
                               labels=['Single', 'Couple', 'Small Family', 'Large Family'])

# Create pivot table for heatmap
pivot_data = df.groupby(['Age_Group', 'Family_Category']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=axes[1,1], 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Number of Customers'})
axes[1,1].set_title('Customer Distribution: Age Group vs Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1,1].set_xlabel('Family Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
